title: Adaptable Immunofluorescence Protocol for Muscle Fiber Typing in FFPE Human and Mouse Skeletal Muscle
author: Thomas, Hibbard, et al.

steps.title: Formalin fixation and paraffin embedding (Basic)
steps.instruction: Fix tissue in formalin and embed in paraffin; total time ≈3 days.

steps.title: Deparaffinize and rehydrate (Basic)
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize and rehydrate tissue sections; total time ≈1.5 hr.

steps.title: Antigen retrieval (Basic)
steps.instruction: Perform antigen retrieval on sections; total time ≈1 hr.

steps.title: Immunofluorescence staining (Basic)
steps.instruction: Stain sections by immunofluorescence; total time ≈3 hr (plus 1 day incubation).

steps.title: Perfusion and fixation (Alt 2)
steps.instruction: Perfuse tissue and fix; total time ≈1 day, 1 hr.
